newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MBf declines to confirm Suria takeover.
newsitem.headline: MBf declines to confirm Suria takeover.

text.p: MBf Capital Bhd on Thursday declined to confirm market rumours that it was planning to take over Suria Capital Bhd.

"We have made an announcement that there was no contact by us with Suria. If there is an opportunity we will be very pleased to discuss (it)," MBf Capital's president and chief executive officer Loy Hean Heang told reporters.
"We cannot talk until there is central bank approval, even unofficially we cannot talk," he said.
However, MBf was looking for acquisitions to grow in the financial sector.
"MBf has always been looking for reasonable business opportunities including a bank," he said.
Asked if any candidates for acquisition had been identified, he said, "there are lots of parties out there, they are all priced very high."
When asked by reporters about rumours he had reduced his stake in MBf capital, he said "no change"
There has been speculation that Loy has put out for sale a large number of MBf Capital shares over the last week.
According to MBf's 1996 annual report, Loy's direct and indirect stake amounted to 31.52 percent of the paid up capital.
